message.zh: 本次重要更新新增意见中心与公告，升级任务、资产和公会经验工具，并完成游戏九种内置语言适配。生产利润和宝箱估算现在默认需要按住 Ctrl，移动端需长按。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: This important update adds the Feedback Center and announcements, upgrades task, asset, and guild XP tools, and supports all nine built-in game languages. Production profit and loot chest estimates now require holding Ctrl by default, or a long press on touch devices. Update on Greasy Fork.
